description: Canonical label definitions for Merge-First draft recovery. Requires explicit provisioning in each target repository; this file does not create GitHub labels.

labels.name: keep-draft
labels.description: Persistent hold: never auto-promote draft or auto-merge; owner must remove

labels.name: not-ready
labels.description: Not ready: prevent automatic draft promotion and merge until resolved

labels.name: overlap-review-needed
labels.description: Review competing or overlapping PR implementations

labels.name: needs-tests
labels.description: Draft or ready PR still needs substantive test evidence

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: PR has a recorded blocker needing attention

note: Re-fetch labels immediately before mark-ready and merge. Missing labels or label API failures must not be silently treated as clearance. Provisioning and enforcement must run under trusted authorization.
